title: Saudi Fried Bread
description: A simple and delicious Saudi-inspired fried bread recipe, perfect for a quick snack or breakfast.

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.notes: Any neutral oil with a high smoke point

instructions: 1. Cut the bread into 1-inch thick slices.
2. Heat a non-stick pan or skillet over medium heat.
3. Add a small amount of oil to the pan and swirl it around.
4. Place 2-3 slices of bread in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
5. Repeat with the remaining bread slices.
6. Serve the fried bread hot, garnished with a sprinkle of salt if desired.
